explanation: The nonce check in verify rejects a token whose nonce has already been seen. Removing it would let an old token be used again. #123 is the related issue.
Call ensure_key_salt before creating KeyManager. If salt setup fails, startup must stop instead of initializing the manager.
Before allocating buf with topN elements, keep topN at or below maxSimpleTopN so the slice stays at or below 1 MiB. maxSimpleTopN is the named limit.
When meta.abi_version is absent, the mapping must produce None. Treating absence as the current ABI would incorrectly accept missing version information. #1784 is the related issue.
The drop-in written under /etc/tlp.d/ can be overridden by /etc/tlp.conf because TLP reads that file last. Both paths are TLP configuration locations.

The set_key call relies on TLP version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV name profile suffixes; the key being set uses _BAT. Leaving the corresponding _AC setting unset preserves GNOME's Performance toggle.
For a JsonException, this catch block returns null. The caller then logs the warning, so this block deliberately does not log or propagate the parse error.
When AllowedTools is set, RemoveSkipPermissions must remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args. That flag bypasses the restrictions supplied through --allowedTools.
For the dead-code decision in thunk_is_dead, consult is_definitely_dead_code in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. The comment points to a verdict table there.
unsure: The comment does not say which verdict in the table applies to this function.

explanation: Replace the fixed repos_skipped value with one derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query(pattern) uses a linear-time DFA, so the regex search does not incur backtracking.
The refresh_tokens schema is coupled to RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. Changes to the token-family tables must be coordinated with that method.
MAX_BATCH is 500 because the vendor's batch API accepts at most 500 items per request. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor API documentation.

The numeric Status values must stay aligned with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Reordering these iota declarations would assign different meanings to integers already stored. #88 is the related issue.
Keep tenant_id first and created_at second in this index. That order matches the orders_by_tenant query; orders_by_tenant names the query that depends on it.
TList.Add must preserve the rule that FCount never exceeds Length(FItems). Grow is the operation that maintains enough capacity.
In close, flush buffered data before closing the sink. Closing drops _buf, so reversing the calls could lose data.
userPath comes from a request. Resolve it relative to workspaceRoot and reject paths that escape that root through .. components; normalization alone does not show the required rejection.
Drain the ring before freeing buf. Otherwise the IRQ handler can access freed memory while processing the ring. #2201 is the related issue.

items.reserve(n) is intended to make one allocation before insertion. Repeated growth during push_back accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Keep HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE so concurrent upserts do not race. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency guidance for MERGE.
PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION makes the audit write independent of the caller's transaction, allowing the audit row to survive a caller rollback.
This migration creates a replacement table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the needed constraints directly. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the relevant ALTER TABLE documentation.
The loop scans every five seconds because NFS mounts do not emit the inotify events this code would need for change notifications.
Keep the awaited run(job) calls in a for...of loop. Using await inside forEach would let errors escape the intended try/catch.
The Vec<u8> returned by read_frame must have a length no greater than MAX_FRAME. The decoder enforces that by rejecting larger frames.
Register drainHook before pool.start() so the pool has its SIGTERM cleanup hook as soon as it starts. The hook drains the pool during shutdown.
Move the hard-coded two-second retry policy into configuration. The work is done when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; #Default names the symbol in that file.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of allowed transitions among LeaseState values, including Active, Released and Stale.
Pass TOKEN to tool login through standard input only. Putting it in argv would expose it through ps to other users.
Create app_reader before granting it SELECT privileges. Migration 042 expects that role to exist.
Make on_event safe to run more than once for the same webhook because Stripe may retry delivery for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook retry documentation.
Compare sig and expected with hmac.Equal. Its constant-time comparison avoids the timing leak that a == comparison could create for MACs.
Build CodeGraph once per index, at a cost proportional to the number of edges. Do not rebuild it for each query.
Changing TCustomerRec's packed layout would make existing saved .dat files incompatible. Bump FILE_VERSION if the layout changes.
Keep MSG_MAX and MSG_MAX_WIRE in proto/messages.h synchronized. Changing this 4096-byte limit requires changing the corresponding wire limit.
handler assumes authMiddleware has run and established a non-null session.userId. Code or types around the handler must preserve that condition.
The cache check and subsequent put must happen atomically. Synchronizing on cache protects that whole sequence; using ConcurrentHashMap alone would not make separate check and put operations atomic.

raw is a user-provided repository alias. validate_alias must check it against the registry before it is used in a path join, preventing an untrusted alias from selecting an unintended path. #1996 is the related issue.
Rows inserted into Payments must have a nonnegative Amount. Refunds are represented as separate rows with Kind = 'R', rather than negative Amount values.
Set stop_ before joining worker_. Otherwise the worker may keep running and join() can block forever.
The limiter accounts for GitHub's stated limit of 5,000 API requests per hour per token. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the REST API rate-limit documentation.
Stop the cidx service before installing its replacement binary at /usr/local/bin/cidx. Replacing the running binary could fail with “Text file busy.”
Do not share the _lease CredentialLease across jobs. Sharing it could expose one user's credentials to another user's job. #77 is the related issue.
Keep len(ids) at or below 999 before binding ids into this DELETE statement. The comment identifies 999 as the SQLite bound-variable limit for one statement.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails, warn and continue the job. A bad memory estimate should degrade containment rather than abort the job.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route. #530 tracks that work; /v1 is the legacy route prefix.
The session model in doc:adr-007#session-model explains why SessionRegistry keeps sessions per tab. The reference points to the session-model section of ADR 007.
This partial index covers only lease rows where released_at IS NULL, matching active-lease lookups by credential_id. The comment reports a 30-fold speedup for that lookup.
Keep the EVENT_TYPES values synchronized with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and the event documentation in docs/events.md. Both paths identify places to update when event types change.
